name: EPIC 210716656
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.5 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,523 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.89 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,743 K at its surface.
